title: Beaches The Musical on Broadway #beachesthemusical #beachesbroadway #...
transcript: The most unrealistic part of this musical is that Jessica Vosk's character can't get a leading role in a summer stock season with the voice that she has. Thankfully, she is front and center in real life, completely carrying this cute but frivolous new musical. I recognize I'm not the target demographic here and Jessica Vosk was the only intriguing factor for me — not the title, not the key art, and certainly not the fact that it's based on a movie. She absolutely delivers in her role as Cee Cee Bloom, the eccentrically charming but impulsive performer and TV personality. The vocals, the comedy, the diva stage presence — it's all there, but Vosk is no magician, she can only do so much with what she's given. In this case, it's a mostly paint-by-numbers musical with forgettable tunes and maybe 25 minutes of real conflict, including the 15-minute intermission. The story follows a lifelong friendship between Cee Cee and Bert with ups and downs, major life milestones, and marriages that are practically irrelevant, paling in comparison to their unbreakable bond. What I felt was missing here was a real explanation of their connection. They are remarkably different, and not in the “opposites attract” sort of way, but in a fundamentally incompatible sort of way. Sure, Elphaba and Glinda are very different too, but there's meaningful exposition in Wicked where they realize the ways in which they're actually similar. In this musical, seemingly the only similarity between these best friends is how much they love the beach. Hopefully, the production team can iron some things out over previews and beef up the story's progression more effectively. I think if you enjoy this show's source material, or you're looking for a light-hearted girls night sort of thing, this totally fits the bill — also, anyone can enjoy Jessica Vosk. Otherwise, the flimsy storytelling and the unearned runtime currently makes this one a hard sell. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
